name: AC1018/R2004 native 2D reading granular evidence coverage
method: Keep original 16 binary milestones unchanged (11 verified, 5 pending). For each of the 5 pending milestones, fix eight explicitly scoped subchecks. A verified macro contributes 8/8 and a pending macro contributes only its individually merged/CI-evidenced subchecks. Equal checklist slots show documented evidence breadth, NOT equal engineering effort, real-world fidelity or release readiness. Do not interpret difference from 68.75% as gain in a single consistent measurement; it is a new finer-grained index.
